name: BT Quote
changelog:
0.3.1

  • The address bar now tracks the tool live — change quantity, garment, locations or method and the URL updates to match, so it is always an accurate quote.
  • Uses replaceState, so adjusting quantity does not stack up back-button steps.
  • Existing tracking params (utm_source, fbclid, …) are preserved when the URL is rewritten.
  • A clean /quote/ stays clean until the customer changes something.
v0.3.0 — Quick Quote tool moved into the plugin as [bt_quick_quote], with prefilled quote links and a Copy Quote Link button.
